# Third-party packages bundled with dst-check

The checker includes these unmodified runtime packages under their original licenses:

- `@sinonjs/fake-timers@15.4.0` — BSD-3-Clause; see `node_modules/@sinonjs/fake-timers/LICENSE`.
- `@sinonjs/commons@3.0.1` — BSD-3-Clause; see `node_modules/@sinonjs/commons/LICENSE`.
- `type-detect@4.0.8` — MIT; see `node_modules/type-detect/LICENSE`.

Scheduler packages are not bundled with the checker. Install the selected scheduler separately in your own project.
